newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen higher on liquidation day.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen higher on liquidation day.

text.p: French shares were expected to open higher on Thursday, the last day of the July Bourse account, underpinned by a firm dollar and rises on other European markets, dealers said.
"The main thing is that the CAC is still lagging behind the DAX index," said a trader.
The CAC-index ended at a record close of 3,003.53 on Wednesday after setting an all-time high earlier in the day at 3,026.99.
